event.title: A Shift in Schedules
event.body: I need you to settle a disagreement between two of my men over the shift hours at the Bluebird Laundry. One insists on starting at dawn, the other wants to begin after the morning rush. It’s a small thing, but the laundry’s manager is growing impatient. Handle it quietly, and I’ll owe you a favor.
event.speaker: elena

choices.label: Mediate the dispute
choices.detail: Bluebird Laundry · $55 · 60 minutes · +5 respect · +0 heat · At 15 heat, police may stop completion. · Russo Outfit standing +6; rival standing −3.

choices.label: arrange a meeting
choices.detail: Bluebird Laundry · $40 · 90 minutes · +5 respect · +0 heat · At 15 heat, police may stop completion. · Russo Outfit standing +6; rival standing −3.

choices.label: push for resolution
choices.detail: Bluebird Laundry · $75 · 45 minutes · +5 respect · +5 heat · At 15 heat, police may stop completion. · Russo Outfit standing +6; rival standing −3.

event.outcome: You completed the requested mediation without violence.

assessment: Speaker and beneficiary align. Concrete shift-hours mediation at a valid venue. Owe-you-a-favor wording remains ambiguous: this operation grants the displayed reward and standing, not a separate callable favor. One sample is not proof of broad semantic coherence.
